title: NEXUS Failure
description: Failures are first-class data (§M2). Every uncaught error, every DB write failure, every agent timeout — structured, tagged, stored. Never just console.error. Written by every module's catch block. Read by: healer, gap-finder, cockpit diagnostic panel.

source.description: Module ID that recorded this failure

error.description: Error message — must be specific, not generic

causedBy.description: UUID of the JAA row or event that triggered this failure

context.description: Relevant context at time of failure (inputs, state snapshot)
